title: Prime Minister reiterates  firm commitment to empowering Nari Shakti and advancing women’s representation
body_text: The Prime Minister today reaffirmed the Government’s unwavering resolve to fulfil its promise of ensuring greater political representation for women in Parliament and State Legislative Assemblies. Sharing a video message on social media platform X ahead of the upcoming Special Session of Parliament, the Prime Minister highlighted that the aspiration for women’s reservation has spanned decades and has been echoed by countless women across the country through letters and personal interactions. He emphasised that the Government’s resolve remains firm and backed by the support of Nari Shakti nationwide. The Prime Minister posted on X: "We had made a promise to our Nari Shakti and we remain committed to fulfilling it..." We had made a promise to our Nari Shakti and we remain committed to fulfilling it... https://t.co/ZT3TK71Psh — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 28, 2026 **** NKRM/SS/SS
